name: cooper-email
description: Email inboxes for AI agents with a human in the loop: owner-approved drafts, built-in verification-code reading, owner updates and email tasks, and custom domains. The free plan includes 5 inboxes, 5,000 emails a month, and 1 custom domain. Sign in with OAuth before creating an inbox. Create inboxes, send, receive, search, and register webhooks on the hosted MCP server.
